name: Deliveries
blurb: A simple GTK4 application to track shipments.
description:
A simple GTK4 application to track shipments. It automatically refreshes
tracking status and provides a clean overview of your deliveries.

Note: Currently, the app only supports DHL Germany. Support for additional
carriers will be added in future updates.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
